title: Remote viewing by becoming the object (awareness-shifting training)
summary: Jordan Jose tells of Remote viewing by becoming the object (awareness-shifting training), about c. 2008–2010 at Baker Victory Services, Western New York, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.
place_text: Baker Victory Services, Western New York

tellings.quote: there was a lot of subconscious uh training to basically help me understand that my awareness could become the door. I could become the room. I could become the filing cabinet where the documents are in and then extract the information that way.

plain: Jordan Jose, who says he was taken into a secret UFO-related programme as a child, tells podcast host Jesse Michels about training he says he received around 2008 to 2010 at a place he names as Baker Victory Services in Western New York. He says a woman he calls Meg trained him, partly below conscious awareness, to treat his awareness as a door, so he could become a room or a filing cabinet and pull out the information in the documents inside. He describes it as a form of remote viewing, gathering information at a distance with the mind alone.
